task_summary: Backtested the London Daybreak (3AM-ET H1 session breakout, 10p buffer, opposite-wick stop, 50p/1:1 target) on EURUSD ~10yr across 3 bias readings — REJECTED, gross-negative (PF 0.82–0.97, exp ≤0R) and decisively net-negative (PF 0.76–0.89, −46% to −53%); entry is a coin-flip at the 35.7% breakeven win-rate line.
